new_value: Fixed in spec/06-security.md §8.13.1 (Freshness and Revocation). Chose option (a): added a verifier-side clock-rollback clamp mirroring the existing issuer-side max(floor+1, time-derived) idiom. New paragraph requires the verifier to persist a monotone floor of the highest observed wall-clock time and evaluate lichen:expiry against max(floor, current time) — never a backward-moved time — closing the rollback path where a spoofed-backward GPS/RTC clock makes an expired revoked fact read as unexpired and (since revocation-by-non-renewal leaves it as the highest-seq fact) re-admits the revoked grant. Also fail-closed: a verifier with no trustworthy time source MUST NOT honor expiring facts; mesh-lifetime facts without freshness claims are unaffected. Spec-only change, no test suite. Note: branch was 71 commits behind main; synced via merge of origin/main first (resolved trust.rs + 04-network.md conflicts by taking origin/main's i72x.2 versions which removed the binding_invariant tests my g9dq comment targeted and unified the 12.2 example — my add9d4cfe4/5sre content was superseded on main; gcp3 JSON relabel survived). 3x codereview: reviewer model stalled within the 120s tool ceiling on a 5th delegation attempt; performed correctness/security/edge passes myself per worker step 4 — all PASS, no findings.
